findings.rationale: Spec-literal and accurate: P3.1 prints the advisory about the cwd's own worktree (directory name vs its branch); that statement is true whether or not the marker followed, so a foreign-repo cwd gets a correct line about the tree it is in. No case needs it silenced.

By design: the sweep keeps a busy worktree whose marker is present but invalid, the conservative direction (never reclaim a live tree it cannot attribute). D10 only narrows the skip for a valid marker, which the D10 test pins.

Correct: the plan header still said "awaiting plan-review". Fixed after this review: the status line now records plan-review done, P1-P4 implemented and reviewed, verify done, in code-review, and links the project README.

One git subprocess per stage transition (a handful per session), well under any hook budget; resolving the session root on every decide is what keeps E1 measured in the worktree the session is in (D5).

The artifacts exist and are tracked on this branch: `git ls-files docs/plans/evidence/2026-10-12-worktree-placement` lists spike-native-worktree.md, moved-assertions.md, walkers.md, p2-red-A.txt, p2-green-B.txt, p2-red-green.json, p2-6-suites.txt, p2-4-foreman-guard.md, p3-red-green.json, p3-suites.txt, receipt-P1..P4.json, p4/gates.txt and verify-suites.txt. This collect excluded `docs/plans/evidence/**` from the review diff (each phase review already covered its own evidence), so the seat could not see them; the links resolve.
Same as the s0 plan-header finding: fixed after this review (status line updated).
